notes: MERGED DOUBLE MARRIAGE (deep-chain audit, 2026-07-03): this record conflates Elizabeth Tilney's two marriages into one. She married first Humphrey Bourchier (I182625982211, d. 14 Apr 1471, killed at Barnet) — their only children were John Bourchier, 2nd Baron Berners, and two daughters (incl. Margaret Bourchier, I182625981492) — then in 1472 married Thomas Howard, later 2nd Duke of Norfolk. The tree's listed children Thomas Howard (I182625982379, b.1473), Elizabeth Boleyn (I182625982382, b.1480), and Muriel Knyvet (I182625982383, b.1485) were all born after Bourchier's death and belong to the Howard marriage, not Bourchier's. Should be split into two separate marriage unions rather than one merged one. — Wikipedia: Elizabeth Tilney, Countess of Surrey; Thomas Howard, 2nd Duke of Norfolk.
